name: Triomphe
summary: 15th-century trick-taking card game ancestor of Euchre and Whist where a random suit becomes trump.
rules_text: Use 52-card French deck, 4 players in two partnerships opposite each other. Deal 5 cards each, place rest as stock and turn top card for trump suit. Dealer or holder of ace of trumps may rob stock, exchanging hand cards for trump cards until a non-trump appears. Eldest leads, must follow suit if possible, otherwise must play trump and overtrump if possible, otherwise discard. Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped. Winning 3 or 4 of 5 tricks scores 1 point, winning all 5 scores 2. First team to 5 points wins game. Spanish 9-card variant plays to 32 points counting 1 per card.
rating_reason: Classic trump trick-taking, hidden hands, clear strategy.
